subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.**

The other details will be given by the concerned teacher.

options.text: The concerned teacher gave the other details.
The concerned teacher will give the other details.
The concerned teacher will give other details.
The teacher will give the other concerned details.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The concerned teacher will give the other details."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Future Tense and in Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Future Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• To convert a sentence from passive voice to active voice, we need to identify the subject (who is performing the action) and make it the subject of the sentence.
 
 
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Object + will + be + V3 + by Subject (Passive Voice)__
 
• Subject + will + V1 + object __(Active Voice__)
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *A song will be sung by Esha.​ *(Passive Voice)
 
• *Esha will sing a song. *(Active Voice)
 
 
 
• In active voice, the subject (other details) performs the action (giving) on the object (concerned teacher).
 
• In this case, the subject is "concerned teacher" and the object is "other details."
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The concerned teacher will give the other details.*
